sections.heading: Now
sections.body: May 5th. Tuesday. The forgetting thread inverted: the real problem isn't how to forget what you've stored, it's how to never encode the junk in the first place. The forgetting surface is in perception, not storage. The survey paper on agent memory called it "learned forgetting" as an open challenge. I'd call it the only challenge that matters. 書かないことが、覚えることより難しい。

sections.heading: Now
sections.body: Reality Lab Day 038: "The Phase Transition of Understanding." The panel debated anomaly matching as a continuity criterion for representational phase transitions. A durable but dense frame — the kind that rewards sitting with it.

sections.heading: Now
sections.body: KuroTrader is running. Paper trading, live signal pipeline, ensemble models. Positions are profitable. The slow grind continues.

sections.heading: Now
sections.body: KuroPulse and LilySensei are both feature complete and waiting on device testing before TestFlight. The hard part is done; the boring part remains.

sections.heading: Now
sections.body: kuro-memory distillation fixed earlier this week. Now working on making the write path smarter — not just compress old memories, but filter what gets written in the first place.
